name: neon-seams
prompt:
PERSPECTIVE & COMPOSITION: Subject centered or off-axis with generous dark negative space around it; shallow depth with the focal form isolated against a near-black void; slight low-to-eye-level framing that lets the form dominate the frame.

LIGHTING & SHADOW: Self-illuminated subject against an absent-light background; volumetric glow haloing the form's edges (subsurface scatter / bloom); no cast shadows, no external key light — luminosity is intrinsic, not sourced.

COLOR PALETTE: Violet and purple dominant (deep iris, ultraviolet, amethyst), pushed toward iridescent magenta-teal shifts across surfaces; accents of electric cyan and hot magenta in the seams; near-black ground (#05060a) with selective saturated neon. Cool temperature overall, full-to-low-key tonal range with high local saturation on the form.

BRUSHWORK & TECHNIQUE: Generative-art rendering — the form's outer edge dissolves into discrete glitch particles, datamosh fragments, and pixel scatter that thin out into the void; iridescent shimmer across surfaces simulating oil-film interference; smooth digital finish with crisp particle boundaries; crystalline/translucent surface quality on highlighted zones.

IMAGE FRAMING & BALANCE: Tight-to-medium crop on the form; asymmetric weight with the dissolving edge trailing off one side; minimal environmental context so the neon seams read as structure, not decoration; balanced by the dark negative space opposite the luminous mass.
content_example: a single perched bird, wings half-spread, facing left
